cohort: The study included 1,001 patients who delivered at Loyola University Medical Center in Maywood, Illinois in 2014.
finding: The odds of having at least one of the studied morbid conditions in pregnancy were greater for patients living in a food desert (adjusted OR 1.64, 95% CI 1.18-2.29).
cross-section timing: Data was collected from electronic medical records of patients who delivered in 2014.
